// Add the approved training montage to the programme overview without disturbing the
// existing programme links or navigation behaviour.
const V64_PROGRAMMES_BASE=routes.programmes;
routes.programmes=function(){
  let html=V64_PROGRAMMES_BASE();
  const marker='<section class="page-section cream">';
  const visual=`<section class="page-section v63-image-showcase"><div class="wrap"><div class="v63-showcase-card"><img src="assets/v63-montage.webp" alt="Jado Kuin Do students and instructors training in the corrected black Jado uniform"><div class="v63-showcase-copy"><div class="kicker">The Jado uniform</div><h2>One identity across every stage of training.</h2><p>The approved imagery now uses the black crossover Jado gi consistently, with the correct JADO / KUIN / DO crest and the stitched red Jado Kuin Do back detail.</p></div></div></div></section>`;
  return html.includes(marker)?html.replace(marker,visual+marker):html;
};

// Add a uniform detail visual to the adults page using the approved stitched back image.
const V64_ADULTS_BASE=routes.adults;
routes.adults=function(){
  let html=V64_ADULTS_BASE();
  const end='</main>';
  const visual=`<section class="page-section alt v63-uniform-detail"><div class="wrap grid-2"><div><div class="kicker">Jado identity</div><h2 style="font-size:48px;line-height:1">The correct Jado gi.</h2><p style="color:#aeb3bc">The back uses bright red stitched JADO KUIN DO lettering with the martial figure beneath it, while the front keeps the black crossover martial-arts cut used throughout the new imagery.</p></div><div class="v63-gi-back"><img src="assets/v63-back-gi.webp" alt="Back of black Jado Kuin Do gi with bright red stitched JADO KUIN DO embroidery"></div></div></section>`;
  return html.includes(end)?html.replace(end,visual+end):html;
};

// V64 CSS for new approved-image sections.
const v63Style=document.createElement('style');
v63Style.textContent=`
.v63-image-showcase{padding-top:28px}.v63-showcase-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #2b313a;border-radius:30px;background:#11151a;min-height:440px}.v63-showcase-card>img{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:440px;display:block;object-fit:cover}.v63-showcase-copy{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;padding:44px 42px 34px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent,rgba(8,10,13,.92) 54%,#080a0d);color:#fff}.v63-showcase-copy h2{font-size:clamp(32px,4vw,55px);line-height:1;margin:7px 0 12px;max-width:760px}.v63-showcase-copy p{max-width:760px;color:#d3d8df}.v63-gi-back{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #303640;border-radius:28px;background:#11151a;min-height:520px}.v63-gi-back img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:520px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center}.v63-uniform-detail h2{color:#fff}.v63-uniform-detail p{font-size:17px;line-height:1.65}.program-photo,.v55-programme-photo,.v43-school-hero-image img{object-fit:cover}.program-photo{object-position:center 32%}
@media(max-width:760px){.v63-showcase-card,.v63-showcase-card>img{min-height:360px}.v63-showcase-copy{padding:26px 22px 22px}.v63-showcase-copy h2{font-size:31px}.v63-showcase-copy p{font-size:14px}.v63-gi-back,.v63-gi-back img{min-height:440px}.v63-uniform-detail .grid-2{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v63-uniform-detail{padding-bottom:100px}}
`;
document.head.appendChild(v63Style);

}
